mode: Built-in imagegen, style-transfer edits of corresponding cat stage references
userDirection: 以金毛犬做原型，猫的三个形态可以参考

selectedPrompts.baby:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: pixel pet game base sprite.
Input reference: this CAT image defines only the established game's flat pixel illustration style, friendly chibi head/body proportions, frontal seated composition and simple face. Replace the cat completely with the requested GOLDEN RETRIEVER. Preserve the game's cheerful appeal, simple large color areas, sparse square pixel details and limited warm palette. This is a dog, no cat ears, no whiskers, no stripes. Absolutely no long hanging spaniel ears and no poodle hair tuft. Use a flat broad slightly fluffy forehead and small folded down retriever ears. Coat is golden over the face and body, with only the small muzzle and chest lighter. No dark heavy outline: contour uses the coat's own deeper gold shade. Fewer, larger square pixel blocks, intended for a 30-40 pixel tall sprite; do not produce detailed small dithering or realistic fur texture.
Composition: ONE complete centered front-facing seated dog, relaxed paws aligned, friendly small smile and bright dark eyes. No huge nose or open mouth. Clean readable silhouette with plenty of transparent margin. Transparent background with real alpha, no floor, no shadows, no cyan background, no text, no logo, no watermark. No accessory. Keep puppy sweetness through adulthood.
Requested dog stage: a very young GOLDEN RETRIEVER puppy. Pale buttery golden fur all over with slightly darker little folded floppy ears, a broad round fluffy head, small dark eyes, small chocolate nose and short cream muzzle, tiny round compact seated body, fat stubby forepaws, a small single puppy tail peeking out at the right. Very young and soft, oversized round head roughly 60% of the total height, plump short body. Head width nearly body width; ears folded down beside cheeks, never pointy. Sitting, squarely facing us. Aim for the simple baby stage charm and proportions of reference.
